concept: ECS: inject Secrets Manager secrets via task definition
tests: How to pass a DB password into a Fargate container without API calls from application code.
expected: The secrets field in the ECS task definition referencing Secrets Manager (or an SSM Parameter) — the value is injected as an env var at task start. Triggers: "injected without the application code calling any API", "least effort".
why_not: Plaintext env var, secret baked into the image, or in an unencrypted S3 bucket — credential leak.
